pages.raw_title: Secure Self Storage Solutions | About Our Company
pages.raw_meta: SmartStop offers secure self storage solutions across 460+ properties in the US and Canada. Learn about our company today!
raw_blocks: SmartStop Self Storage (“SmartStop ® ”) is a leading provider of convenient and secure self-storage solutions offering state-of-the-art facilities with a wide variety of unit sizes to meet your storage needs.

Based in Ladera Ranch, California, SmartStop has an owned or managed portfolio of approximately 475 operating properties in 36 states, Washington, D.C., and Canada, totaling more than 36.7 million rentable square feet. Its portfolio of facilities includes 70 self-storage properties in Canada. SmartStop employs a fully integrated operations team of more than 1,000 self-storage professionals and is one of the largest self-storage operators in North America.
SmartStop owns, operates, manages, develops, and redevelops self-storage facilities. The SmartStop Self Storage brand was founded in 2009 by H. Michael Schwartz, its CEO and Executive Chairman.

SmartStop Self Storage provides a wide range of storage solutions tailored to diverse needs. From personal storage for individuals seeking secure and convenient spaces, to business solutions for inventory and file storage, to specialized options for car , boat , and RV storage . Additionally, we offer solutions for students and military personnel, recognizing unique storage needs and providing reliable options to suit their specific requirements.

Wherever our customers are on their journey, SmartStop is the simplified self-storage company that provides an inviting, fresh and human experience. We are committed to making the self-storage experience easy and hassle free.
Life is complicated, but storage shouldn't be. ®

SmartStop is driven to provide an exemplary experience for our consumers, our stockholders and our employees. From our corporate office to our properties, we believe in Leading Together, Embracing Change and Enhancing Everyone’s Journey.
SmartStop is proud to support charitable causes that make a big difference in peoples’ lives. Learn more about the programs and organizations we support .
Think National. Act Local. ®

With over 200 locations across the United States and Canada, we understand self storage across a broad range of customer groups. Our facilities are built, our team members are trained, and our service offering is designed from our experience with a large portfolio that spans diverse communities.

We realize our customers and our employees reside and participate in these communities, and it is within them that we have the best opportunity to be positive influences and agents of change. This perspective impacts everything we do, from how we make hiring decisions to how we interact with and serve others. This is what we mean when we say: think national. act local. ®
Finding a storage unit was stressful, but Leo was very helpful in my search for extra space for my stuff."

Great storage facility, friendly staff. Nothing but a positive experience.”

pages.raw_title: Secure Business and Commercial Storage Solutions | SmartStop Self Storage
pages.raw_meta: Find secure business storage units for documents, inventory, and equipment. Flexible rent options for commercial needs at SmartStop locations.
raw_blocks: Business Storage Units Should Be Your Next Office Partner.

Owning and operating your own business can be a financially and personally rewarding venture. However, as your company grows and you take on more clients and staff, you might just run out of office space . A cluttered office doesn't inspire confidence with your customers, which is why so many businesses store their valuables with us. Whether you own a large business or are just launching a start-up, our commercial storage solutions may be the alternative you need. Let us help you store The SmartStop Way®.
Need Business Reasons to Store?
If your business is all about dollars and sense, think of SmartStop Self Storage. We’re not just a storage place, we’re your business solutions place.

Relocating to another office with more space isn’t necessarily the wisest decision unless it is part of your overall business plan. Some companies are committed to a long-term lease, want to operate near a specific market or reach a particular demographic that a change of scenery can’t accommodate. If this is the case, moving might be the last thing your business needs.

Storage rentals that operate on a month-to-month basis offer the flexibility that most companies desire. You don’t need to rent units until your business requires the extra space. This gives you a chance to focus on growing your business without worrying about unexpected costs.
Security remains a primary concern for most business owners. When you run out of space at your office, you can protect your products by keeping them in a reliable storage container.

If your company deals with large amounts of paper documents, you will definitely benefit from leasing storage units. Many units reside in restricted access areas where only authorized personnel can enter. You can also choose climate controlled storage rentals, which provide further protection from moisture condensation, mold buildup and mildew. It's The Smarter Way To Store ® .
We know that you most likely operate within a nearby community and want easy access to your products. Our gate hours are from 6am to 10pm so you can get your things when you need to.
